meta_description:
aditiraval on October 6, 2026: "Some cars are designed to make an impression.
The new Škoda Slavia is designed to make a statement.

With its distinctive style, confident stance and the substance that Škoda is known for, the new Slavia brings together elegance and everyday practicality.

And now, starting at ₹9.99 lakh (ex-showroom, India).

Customer deliveries begin next week.

#SkodaSlavia #SkodaIndia #SlaviaSaysItAll".
